scope: DEI-T12/T17/T18: canonical origin admission and accepted snapshot reuse
evidence: Canonical mixed batch stages progress first, then refuses an implementation backed by a revoked receipt or obsolete selector scope. Outer commit after the caught error leaves zero executions, records, events and handler rows; the original receipt/revocation remains.
Added a Target after the accepted observation; same Card and file path do not permit executing that new Target using the earlier receipt. Changed Target revision is also refused.
Strengthened both obsolete-scope cases with the real resolution service and SQL adapters: CodeInvestigationSelectorScopeMismatch is raised and no resolution is persisted.
The selector digest binds Board, Card version and the complete active Target ID/revision set. Accepted receipt reuse does not infer scope from a matching path or Target name.

Two Targets covered by one admitted snapshot produce two execution rows referencing the same receipt, without adding requests or receipts; exact replay retains 2 executions, 3 bindings, 2 events and 2 handler rows.
Origin authorization, trust, allowlist and typed input remain shared with the standalone submission path; inline single and batch retain commit/rollback/replay semantics.

limits: Observations are accepted-fact fixtures. Tests exercise real admission against their persisted scope/revocation and real origin use cases; they do not claim a fresh attestation handshake E2E.

No UI/product change. Current main86 frontend and closure evidence remain applicable; no new frontend run is counted.

No legacy reader, conversion, migration, promotion or real-data mutation.
